Module.Name: Background food concentrations
Module.Description: Background food concentrations comprise food occurrence data on naturally occurring levels of specific substances in food commodities (e.g. CS2 associated with dithiocarbamates). These data support the correction of measured residue levels by accounting for and subtracting the natural background contribution.
